text:
lee: FYI our nightly integration suite started failing in eu-west after the SDK pin to 2.7. Trace shows handshake errors between sdk-client and runtime. Logs: https://ci.internal/ints/4421
anita: Error sample?
lee: `ERROR: protocol mismatch: client v2.7 -> runtime v3.0` plus some transient connection resets on longpoll. Repro is flaky.
tom: That's risky if we unpin globally. How much traffic is affected?
lee: Only integration tests and internal staging agents (~20 calls/min). No prod traffic.
infra-bot: pincheck: sdk redwood-sdk@2.7 pinned to runtime 3.0 in eu-west (scope: regional).
deploybot: Available actions:
```
# Temporary unpin for region
deploybot unpin sdk redwood-sdk@2.7 --region eu-west --reason "integration-suite" --until 2025-07-01
# Quick revert
deploybot pin sdk redwood-sdk@2.7 --region eu-west --runtime 3.0 --reason "reapply-pin"
```
anita: Proposal: grant a short regional exemption (eu-west) for 12h so tests can run, but require smoke and telemetry.
lee: I'll attach smoke script infra/ci/smoke-sdk-handshake.sh and a minimal replay of our test payloads.
devops: Need 2 approvals per policy for unpin exemptions. I can approve once smoke passes in canary.
tom: +1 if we scope to eu-west and set routing to internal-only 0.05% for sanity checks. Also add telemetry tag `sdk-exempt-handshake` and set an alert on handshake_error_rate > 0.5%.
deploybot: exemption request created: id ex-20250701-07. Waiting approvals: devops, anita.
anita: approved. Note: require auto-repin at expiry and enable verbose SDK logs for 1h after change.
devops: approved. I'll watch the canary and trigger pin back if error_rate > 1% for any 5m window.
deploybot: Exemption granted until 2025-07-01T12:00:00Z. Applied telemetry tag: sdk-exempt-handshake. Auto-pin scheduled.
lee: Rolling change now (eu-west only). Running smoke now.
lee: smoke passed local checks. Kicking integration suite. Will report back in 20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
lee: Integration run green. No new handshake errors in 40m. Closing exemption. Will open a ticket to investigate protocol fallback handling: #TICKET-8891.
infra-bot: Reminder: auto-pin will still occur at expiry unless manually extended.
lee: Noted. We'll triage TICKET-8891 and propose either a client-side tolerant handshake or runtime compatibility shim. Thanks all. :metal:
